tax.text: He voted against a Republican tax plan and supports ending tax breaks for the wealthiest Americans.
tax.quote: Congressman Pallone opposed the partisan Republican tax plan, and voted no when it was considered by the House of Representatives.

wages.text: He supports significantly raising the minimum wage and strengthening workplace protections.
wages.quote: Congressman Pallone supports policies that would significantly raise the minimum wage, implement equal work for equal pay and paid family leave.

debt.text: He says he is committed to protecting and strengthening Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.
debt.quote: Congressman Pallone is committed to protecting the programs that seniors rely on, like Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security, while also making them stronger and more secure.

schools.text: He says local schools and teachers need adequate resources and compensation.
schools.quote: Congressman Pallone believes local schools and teachers must be provided with adequate resources and compensation, and a strong emphasis must be placed on hiring and retaining highly trained and talented teaching professionals.

abortion.text: He called for federal protection of reproductive health care, including abortion.
abortion.quote: Congressman Frank Pallone, Jr. (NJ-06) called for federal protection of the right to full reproductive health care services, including abortion, contraception, and IVF.

energy.text: He introduced the CLEAN Future Act, which sets a goal of a 100 percent clean economy by 2050.
energy.quote: The CLEAN Future Act formally adopts the goal of achieving of a 100 percent clean economy by 2050.

tax.text: Her campaign says she will fight to lower property taxes and living costs.
tax.quote: Hillary will fight for lower property taxes, reduced cost of living, and keeping more of your paycheck in your home.

schools.text: Her campaign says families should be able to choose their children’s learning environment.
schools.quote: Families deserve the freedom to choose the best learning environment for their kids.

cannabis.text: Her campaign supports removing federal cannabis prohibition and establishing federal regulation.
cannabis.quote: Hillary supports responsible cannabis reform, including removing federal prohibition and employment penalties for lawful cannabis use.

energy.text: Her campaign emphasizes diversifying energy supplies and lowering energy costs.
energy.quote: Reliable Energy: Upgrade the grid; Diversify energy, lower costs, smart placement of solar, not on agricultural fields
